inputs.prompt: Redraw <image1> as a frame of traditional hand-drawn Japanese gothic fantasy anime, using ONLY the INK LINEWORK and CEL-SHADING style of <image2>. The composition, characters, actions, identity, camera and scene must all come from image1, NOT image2. Match image2 clean dark ink contours, flat matte skin colors, hard-edged two-tone cel shadows, broad connected anime hair locks with flat highlight bands, graphic fabric folds and hand-drawn embroidered motifs. No glossy 3D skin, no photorealistic hair strands, no physically based cloth or metal shading, no CGI, no doll rendering. Preserve her height, side-facing full-body standing pose, the adult black-and-gold robed priest's palm resting on her shoulder, the stairs behind them, and the visible violet torch. The girl's face and whale hood design must stay hers; do NOT turn her into the orange-haired woman in image2. The priest towers above her, positioned on the right.
